MCMC settings for apc_bayes()

Source: R/model-apc_bayes.R
mcmc_control.Rd

Presets: "fast" (5,000 iterations, burn-in 1,000, thinning 5; suitable for backtests), "final" (bamp's automatic choice of chain length), and "test" (1,000 iterations, for examples and unit tests only).

Usage

mcmc_control(
  preset = c("fast", "final", "test"),
  iterations = NULL,
  burn_in = NULL,
  thin = NULL,
  tuning = NULL,
  parallel = TRUE
)

Arguments

preset

"fast", "final" or "test".

iterations, burn_in, thin

Override the preset.

tuning

Tuning iterations.

parallel

Run the four chains in parallel. bamp runs them in a socket cluster without seeded random number streams, so results differ slightly between runs even when a seed is set.

Value

A list.

Examples

mcmc_control("fast")
#> $options
#> $options$number_of_iterations
#> [1] 5000
#> 
#> $options$burn_in
#> [1] 1000
#> 
#> $options$step
#> [1] 5
#> 
#> $options$tuning
#> [1] 500
#> 
#> 
#> $parallel
#> [1] TRUE
#> 
#> $preset
#> [1] "fast"
#>
